name: Palmyra X 004
description: Enterprise model built for business writing and brand-consistent content.
longDescription: Palmyra X 004 is Writer's flagship enterprise model, designed specifically for business content generation. It excels at maintaining brand voice consistency, following style guides, and generating high-quality marketing, sales, and corporate content.

codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.writer.com/v1/chat",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $WRITER_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"model": "palmyra-x-004", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]}
)
print(response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
